name: Hero
summary: A page's opening statement: kicker, headline, lede and actions, beside a decorative object or a figure.

guidance.useFor: The top of a home page or a landing page: one headline that says what the site is, a sentence, and one or two actions. With a figure as its object it is the split hero, for a case study's opener.
insteadUse: The top of an article: Article header
A call to act later in the page: CTA band
content: The headline says what you do, not "Welcome"
One primary action at most, and a second that is quieter
A figure as the object needs alt text; decorative art doesn't

rungReason: A <section> named by its h1 through aria-labelledby; art is aria-hidden SVG. No script.

keyboard.action: Follows or presses the focused action

rules: Sized to its content, never 100vh, so zoom and short screens don't hide the actions
Hero text is checked against every satin fold (body 7:1, muted 4.5:1); under increased contrast the satin switches off
The art is aria-hidden; a figure used as the object keeps its alt text and caption
The object stacks under the text when either would be narrower than 27rem (WCAG 1.4.10)
contrast: The satin backdrop is hidden; text sits on the page's surface
forcedColors: The satin is hidden; system text colours
